title: Handley Page Halifax JP137
memorial_details: Stone of remembrance with a triangular pediment set on a marble base with two miliary badges centrally and the lettering in white.
inscription: MOORDOWN/ HALIFAX MEMORIAL/ IN MEMORY OF THE TWO LOCAL RESIDENTS/AND SEVEN AIRCREW WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ IN THE CAUSE OF FREEDOM/ WHEN RAF HALIFAX BOMBER JP 137 CRASHED/ AT THIS LOCATION ON 21st MARCH 1944./ (Names)/ 'LEST WE FORGET'/ ORGANISED BY THE MOORTOWN 2010 COMMITTEE/ AS A CONTRIBUTION TO THE BICENTENARY OF BOURNEMOUTH.
community_connection: Two local residents lost their lives.
